001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents an activity outside the home and school categories, with an
007 * associated location such as a clinic or gym. Common fields and behavior are
008 * inherited from {@link Activity}.
009 * </p>
010 * <p>
011 * Example:
012 * </p>
013 * <code>new OtherActivity("Appointment", start, end, "Clinic")</code>
014 */
015public class OtherActivity extends Activity {
016    /**
017     * The physical location where this activity takes place. Must be non-null and non-blank.
018     */
019    private String location;
020
021
022
023    /*
024     * Constructors
025     */
026    
027    /**
028     * Constructs an <code>OtherActivity</code> with a title, start time, end time,
029     * and location.
030     * 
031     * @param title     The activity title.
032     * @param startTime The start time.
033     * @param endTime   The end time.
034     * @param location  The activity location.
035     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title or location is null or blank,
036     *                                  if startTime or endTime is null, or if
037     *                                  startTime is not strictly before endTime.
038     */
039    public OtherActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String location)
040    throws IllegalArgumentException {
041        super(title, startTime, endTime);
042        setLocation(location);
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * Constructs an <code>OtherActivity</code> with a title, start time, end time,
047     * comment, and location.
048     * 
049     * @param title     The activity title.
050     * @param startTime The start time.
051     * @param endTime   The end time.
052     * @param comment   The activity comment.
053     * @param location  The activity location.
054     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If title or location is null or blank,
055     *                                  if startTime or endTime is null, or if
056     *                                  startTime is not strictly before endTime.
057     */
058    public OtherActivity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment, String location)
059    throws IllegalArgumentException {
060        super(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
061        setLocation(location);
062    }
063
064    /**
065     * Constructs an <code>OtherActivity</code> from a RAS (Readable Activity
066     * Serial) string.
067     * 
068     * @param ras Serialized entry.
069     * @throws RasException when RAS input is invalid.
070     */
071    public OtherActivity(String ras)
072    throws RasException {
073        super(ras);
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * <p>
078     * Copy constructor. Constructs a new <code>OtherActivity</code> that is a
079     * duplicate of the given <code>OtherActivity</code>, preventing co-references
080     * that could cause privacy leaks.
081     * </p>
082     *
083     * @param other The <code>OtherActivity</code> to copy.
084     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
085     */
086    public OtherActivity(OtherActivity other)
087    throws IllegalArgumentException {
088        super(other);
089        setLocation(other.getLocation()); // String is immutable; no copy needed
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Creates and returns a copy of this {@code OtherActivity}.
094     * 
095     * @return A duplicate copy of this OtherActivity.
096     */
097    @Override
098    public Activity copy() {
099        return new OtherActivity(this);
100    }
101
102
103
104    /*
105     * Accessors and Mutators
106     */
107
108    /**
109     * Gets the location of this activity.
110     * 
111     * @return The activity location.
112     */
113    public String getLocation() {
114        return this.location;
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * Sets the location of this activity.
119     * 
120     * @param location The new location.
121     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If location is null or blank.
122     */
123    public void setLocation(String location)
124    throws IllegalArgumentException {
125        if (location == null || location.isBlank())
126            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Location cannot be null or blank.");
127        this.location = location;
128    }
129
130
131
132    /*
133     * Activity Overrides
134     */
135
136
137    
138    /**
139     * Returns the {@link dayplanner.ActivityType} that corresponds to this
140     * Activity.
141     * 
142     * @return Corresponding ActivityType. For OtherActivities, this is
143     *         <code>OTHER</code>.
144     */
145    @Override
146    public ActivityType getType() {
147        return ActivityType.OTHER;
148    }
149
150
151
152    /*
153     * Object Overrides
154     */
155
156    /**
157     * Determines whether this activity is equal to another object.
158     * 
159     * @param other The object to compare with.
160     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
161     *         otherwise.
162     */
163    @Override
164    public boolean equals(Object other) {
165        if (this == other)
166            return true;
167        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
168            return false;
169        if (!super.equals(other))
170            return false;
171        OtherActivity that = (OtherActivity) other;
172        if (getLocation() == null)
173            return that.getLocation() == null;
174        return getLocation().equals(that.getLocation());
175    }
176
177    /**
178     * Returns a string representation of this activity.
179     * 
180     * @return A string representation of this activity.
181     */
182    @Override
183    public String toString() {
184        String ret = String.format("%s (%s - %s at %s)",
185            getTitle(),
186            getStartTime().toString(),
187            getEndTime().toString(),
188            getLocation());
189
190        String com = getComment();
191        if (com != null)
192            ret = ret + " (" + com + ")";
193
194        return ret;
195    }
196
197
198    
199    /*
200     * Serialization
201     */
202
203    /**
204     * Encodes this activity into RAS (Readable Activity Serial) format.
205     * 
206     * @return One-line RAS entry including the location after the inherited fields.
207     */
208    public String toRAS() {
209        return RasParser.serialize(this);
210    }
211}
